<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex9012024-10-0913-15-03" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon">
         <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (33a5–33b3)"/>         
         <pb n="33b"/><lb n="33b1"/> <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4505">bde bar gshegs pa dang phyi rol pa'i gzhung rnam par 'byed pa</rs> zhes bya ba ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">blo gsal zhing rigs par smra ba brtul shugs legs par gnas pa ¦ rang dang gzhan mtha' dag gi gzhung la <lb n="33b2"/> ma rmongs pa dge slong chos kyi seng ge</rs>s <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5586">rtog ge la 'bar ba</rs> dang <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7344"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3723">shes rab sgron ma</rs>'i gtig</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7473">btsun pa spyan ras gzigs</rs> kyis phye ba dang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3732">slob dpon zhi ba mtsho</rs>s sbyar pa'i <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7416">tshad ma de <choice><orig>kh°</orig><reg>kho</reg></choice> na bsdus pa</rs> dang | <lb n="33b3"/> <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:7417">de'i 'grel pa</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3735">slob dpon ka ma la shi la</rs>s sbyar ba dang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3725">slob dpon zla ba grags pa</rs>'i <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3726">dbu ma la 'jug pa</rs>'i gzhung rnams las bsdus ste | legs par sbyar pa rdzogs s+ho || ||</seg></TEI>
